messages.subject: rapid convergence of 4pl model
parts:
hi,

i am fitting the 2PL-4PL on a complex dataset and the 4PL converges in 3 iterations while the 2PL doesn't converge within 500 steps. Is there an explanation for this rapid convergence of the 4PL? Or is this a sign i am doing something wrong?

Best, felix

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: rapid convergence of 4pl model
parts:
Other than a complete crash in the M-step I can't imagine why this would happen. Have you tried other optimizers, like 'nlminb'? Note that if the 2PL doesn't converge, you're probably SOL at obtaining the 3-4PL models given their impressive instability. 

Phil

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: rapid convergence of 4pl model
parts:
I wish that were the case. Some R optimizers will simply terminate immediately "thinking" they are at some type of maximum, and return no warnings or error codes (I try to throw warnings when I suspect this happens). The BFGS family has a tendency to do this more than the nlminb minimizers for some reason though, but the latter is less efficient. 

Phil
